publicChannels.logging-source: GitHub repository traffic statistics (views, clones, popular paths) captured nightly by compliance/scripts/github_traffic_report.py and archived with the trust-access evidence set
publicChannels.logging-credential: GH_TRUST_TOKEN, a fine-grained token carrying Administration read on this repository, the permission GitHub's traffic endpoints require, alongside the Contents permission the publish step uses
publicChannels.logging-note: Anonymous raw reads cannot be provider-logged, so GitHub's own repository traffic statistics are the authoritative summary for this channel and the documented limit of what the host provides - an owner determination recorded as ATT-2026-08-18-07, not an assumption. The nightly capture archives to the Locked 400-day compliance-evidence container, building the continuous history GitHub's own rolling 14-day window cannot hold. First archived capture: build 2598, 32 views from 4 unique visitors and 141 clones from 59 unique cloners, all three endpoints HTTP 200. A capture that is not fully available is archived as an explicit coverage gap with its per-endpoint statuses, never as zero traffic.

controlledAccessPolicy.presumption: Approve verified agency requests for the Tarly Cowork FedRAMP Certification Package.
controlledAccessPolicy.identity-verification: Verify the requester's agency affiliation and official contact channel before delivery.
approval-criteria: Requester is acting for a government agency or its authorized assessor.
Request concerns Tarly Cowork package FR2628650874 and supports an authorization, assessment, oversight, or procurement decision.
Requester accepts the handling restrictions and time-limited authenticated HTTPS delivery method.
denial-criteria: Identity or agency affiliation cannot be verified.
Requested material is unrelated to the Tarly Cowork Certification Package or the stated official purpose.
Requested delivery would violate law, contract, FedRAMP direction, or another agency's confidentiality; offer a safe subset when possible.
controlledAccessPolicy.approved-delivery-method: Time-limited authenticated HTTPS bundle with manifest, SHA-256 hashes, schema and media-type metadata, signature verification metadata, and retained delivery receipt.
controlledAccessPolicy.logging-note: Every controlled attempt, served or denied, appends an immutable trust_retrieval_log row before the caller is answered. The retained production summary carries 22 rows from 2026-08-15T19:33:40Z to 2026-08-18T02:51:41Z with both immutability triggers enabled; all are denials, because no production entitlement has been issued and no external party has requested controlled access. The served path is retained from the 2026-08-14 staging lifecycle exercise (12 rows, 7 served with digests). Rows cannot be updated or deleted, so the underlying retention is unbounded; desensitized summaries archive with the trust-access evidence set in the Locked 400-day compliance-evidence container.

privacy: No client address, token, or user identity is included in this desensitized summary.
